get.summary: Every account with its type, currency, state and today's balance.

post.summary: Creates a manual account, with its opening balance when given.

delete.summary: Deletes the account with its movements and balances, only when nothing rests on it (`conflict`, reason `in_use`).

get.summary: One account with its settings. Another person's account is `not_found`.

patch.summary: Changes an account's settings: a field left out keeps its value, `iban: null` removes the IBAN. A synced account keeps its currency.

post.summary: Archives an account: it keeps its history and leaves the lists. `restore` brings it back.

get.summary: The recorded balances of one account, newest first; `limit` 1-200, 200 when missing or not a number.

post.summary: Records the balance of a day, as the form does: a second reading of the same day replaces the first.

delete.summary: Deletes a balance a person recorded.

put.summary: Corrects a balance a person recorded; any other source is `conflict`.

get.summary: What an account's page shows around its figures: its provider, Investments, the pockets, subscriptions and interest rules on it, and the switch to the bank.
One account day by day from `from` to `to` (both included, at most 1100 days, cut at today): readings held, a synced account rebuilt from its movements.
What rests on the account and has to move before it can be deleted, and the open accounts it can move to.

post.summary: Moves one thing that rests on the account to another open account.

get.summary: What hangs off an account: direct debits on its IBAN, charges on its card.

post.summary: Adds what hangs off an account; the same name twice on one channel is `conflict`.

delete.summary: Removes what hangs off an account.

put.summary: Changes what hangs off an account.

post.summary: Brings an archived account back.

delete.summary: «Undo switch»: the account goes back to its source of before.

post.summary: Applies the switch the report described: only with the report's `fingerprint` (`conflict`, reason `stale`).

get.summary: The step «Account» of the switch: the accounts of the person's banks in the account's currency that it can move to. No IBAN, whole or masked (H45): only whether it is the account's own.

post.summary: The dry run of moving the account to a bank's account: the report the person reads before «Apply».

get.summary: The person's Client APIs (client credentials), newest first. Never a secret.

post.summary: Creates a Client API and answers its secret once: only its hash is kept.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the person's Client APIs; its tokens stop working at once.

get.summary: The banks of a country the bank plugin can connect.

post.summary: Starts the access to a bank: the answer is the bank's page.

get.summary: The person's categories in tree order, with how many movements each has.

post.summary: Creates a category or a group.

delete.summary: Deletes a category for good, and at the source it came from. `external` says what the source did.

patch.summary: Changes a category's name, group or colour.

post.summary: Archives a category, with the sub-categories of a group. `ids` is what «Undo» restores.

get.summary: What moving a group to another macro changes, before the move: movements, total, linked records.

post.summary: Moves a group, or a category of Transfers, to another macro. The numbers change; `undo` takes it back.
Moves a category to another group of the same macro. `fromId` is the group it left.
The default groups the person chose, in their language, then a pass of the cascade after the answer; answers how many were made.
Undoes a move to another macro with the `undo` the move answered.
Merges two categories: movements, sub-categories and budget limits of `dropId` go to `keepId`.
«They are different»: the pair is not proposed again.
«Undo» of «They are different».
Undoes a merge with the `undo` the merge answered.
Brings archived categories back: one, or every one an archive put away.

get.summary: The apps the person gave consent to, oldest first: the devices of the apps among them.

delete.summary: Takes a consent back: the app's refresh tokens go, and its next sign-in asks again.

get.summary: The person's connections with their state, schedule, capabilities and last runs.

post.summary: Connects a provider that takes credentials. The fields of `credentials` are the ones the provider's descriptor names.

delete.summary: Disconnects: the credentials go, the accounts and movements stay. Also cancels a bank connection not finished.

get.summary: The accounts the provider exposes now, and which of them the person chose.

put.summary: Chooses the accounts of a connection: a new account, an account here, or left out.

post.summary: «Turn on» the plugin of the connection; each of its connections is read at once.
Reads the history again, `months` back: one of `capabilities.historyMonths`.
Tries the first reading of a bank again, now, after a refusal.
Renews the access to a bank before or after it ends: the answer is the bank's page.
«Turn on again»: the provider's recommended schedule.

put.summary: Saves when the connection is read: times in the person's zone. No rule is «only by hand».

post.summary: The next passes of a schedule not saved yet, in the person's zone, and what is wrong with it. Saves nothing.
«Update now»: a reading in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait; the run is in `runs`.
Tries the saved credentials against the provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The person's labels, with how many movements carry each.

post.summary: Creates a label.

delete.summary: Deletes a label; the movements keep everything else.

patch.summary: Changes a label's name or colour.

get.summary: The version of the instance, the level of its API and what it can do.
The net worth and every account by month end, through `through` (this month when missing), for `months` months (1-120, 24 when missing).
The accounts «in the net worth» day by day from `from` to `to`, in the display currency at the rate of each day: at most the last 366 days of the window, cut at today.
The payees whose name contains the text, with how many movements each has (the ⌘K palette).
Everyone who can reach the instance: the users, then the invitations still outstanding.

delete.summary: Deletes a person and everything they own. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

patch.summary: Changes a person's role or blocks them. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

post.summary: Emails a person a link to choose a new password.

delete.summary: Turns a person's two-factor sign-in off, for a lost device.

post.summary: Invites a person by email. `outcome` says whether the email left, or why it did not.

delete.summary: Withdraws an invitation: its link stops working.

patch.summary: Turns a plugin on or off for the person.

delete.summary: Removes the credentials of a plugin's application.

put.summary: Checks and saves the credentials of a plugin's application. The key never comes back.

get.summary: The person's preferences: language, zone, number format, display currency, theme, time off.

patch.summary: Changes some preferences; a field left out keeps its value. A new zone moves the sync times with it.

get.summary: Who the token acts for: name, email, role, and whether the identity provider manages them.

patch.summary: Changes the person's name. Refused with `conflict` (`reason: sso`) when the provider manages it.

get.summary: What the Profile form offers: the time zones with their offset now, and whether the instance sends the monthly summary.
The person's rules in their order, each with how many movements carry its category. With `category`, only the rules that give that category.

post.summary: A new rule; answers how many movements already here it would change. `conflict`, `reason` `limit`, when the person has as many rules as allowed.

put.summary: Changes a rule; answers how many movements already here it would change.
Turns a rule on or off.

post.summary: «Apply» to the movements already here (§4.6): all or nothing, with «Undo».

get.summary: What «Apply to existing transactions» would change, and the rule's category.

post.summary: «Undo» of the deletion of a rule.
«Undo» of an «Apply».

get.summary: The editor filled from a movement (§4.7) or with a category chosen (§5.4); `draft: null` when neither gives one.

put.summary: The rules in their new order: the first that matches wins.

post.summary: The live preview of the editor: what the rule would change. `ruleId` leaves the rule being edited out. A rule not valid yet is `invalid`. Writes nothing.

get.summary: The person's pockets, funds and subscriptions whose name contains the text.
How the person signs in: password, identity provider (its origin only) and the instance's second-factor policy.

post.summary: Makes a backup of the database now and answers its size in bytes.

get.summary: Whether each plugin of the instance answers. A plugin that does not is `down` in its row; `503` only when the check cannot run.
Every job of the worker with its last run.

post.summary: Puts one job in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait: the run is in `GET /server/jobs`.

delete.summary: Removes the AI service and its key.

put.summary: Saves the AI service that reads a document when its reader cannot. An empty key keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Tries the saved key and model. Saves nothing; the service's answer is never quoted.

delete.summary: Removes the saved provider: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the sign-in provider. A new issuer signs everyone out (`signedEveryoneOut`).

post.summary: Reads the discovery document of the saved provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The AI service, the sign-in provider, the mail transport and the maintenance facts. No secret.

delete.summary: Removes the saved transport: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the mail transport and which emails go out. An empty password keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Sends one email to the admin who asked, through the transport as it is saved.

get.summary: The person's open sign-ins on the web, newest first. Never a session token.

delete.summary: Signs one session out. A session that is not the person's answers as one already gone.

get.summary: The last 24 monthly snapshots, newest first (Settings › Data).

post.summary: «Take snapshot now»: the run the monthly job does, for the month of `on` (the previous month when missing). It replaces that month's snapshot.

get.summary: Every category the person's sources bring, and where its movements count here.

put.summary: Sets where a source's category counts: a category of the person, or its own (`null`).

post.summary: «Keep as it is» on a new category of a source: it stays added and is no longer new.
Undoes a change of where a source's category counts.
Brings back an account deleted here: the source may bring it again. A bank's account is chosen again on `reconnect`.
Turns a source off after a last reading: its accounts are kept by hand from now.

get.summary: What turning a source off changes, before it is turned off.
Net worth, liquid cash, and this month's income, spending and net (the Home Assistant card).
Movements filtered like Expenses, with the totals of the whole filtered range (not just the page). Without `limit`, 500 rows.
One movement, as the pages draw it. Another person's movement is `not_found`.

patch.summary: The fields a person owns on a movement: its note (trimmed; empty is none) and its labels. Payee, amount and date belong to the source (`conflict`, reason `provider_owned`).

get.summary: The movements with the same text as this one that may take `categoryId` too (decision K3). Writes nothing.

patch.summary: Type, amount, payee and note of a movement its source lets change: written there first, then here. `conflict` with `reason` `not_linked` or `no_transfer_category`, or the source's own words when it refused; `unavailable` with its words when it could not be reached.

post.summary: The category chosen for a group or for similar movements: all of them or none. With «Undo».
«Confirm»: an automatic category or a suggestion becomes the person's own choice. With «Undo».
«Undo» of a confirmation or a choice.

put.summary: One category, or none, for a selection of movements; answers how many changed.

get.summary: How many movements each account, category and type holds in a filtered range.

post.summary: Writes a manual movement. `key` is the dialog's own: a second request with it answers with the row already written (`created: false`). `invalid` with `reason` `amount` or `future_date`; `conflict` with `reason` `account_unavailable`.

delete.summary: Deletes a manual movement and rebuilds its account's balance.

put.summary: Changes a manual movement; a movement of a source is `conflict`, `reason` `not_manual`.

post.summary: «Retry sending» a manual movement its source did not take: the source is updated now. `sent` says whether it went; why not is the connection's state.

get.summary: What the dialog of a manual movement offers: the accounts that take one, in the order of Accounts, with the source a «read and write» account sends it to, and today where the person is.

post.summary: Today's balance of the account before and after the movement being written, or the day of the reading that keeps it unchanged; null when there is nothing to say. Writes nothing.
The category the cascade would give the movement being written, from what is already known; null for none. Nothing is learnt or written.

get.summary: «To review» for a range: the accounts whose movements take an automatic category, the groups and the single movements waiting for one, the pairs of categories that look like the same one, and whether the first pass is still running. Without `accounts`, every account that takes one.
The movements of a filtered range summed by category, by day or by month, giroconti left out unless `type` is `transfer`.
What Expenses draws for a filter: a page of rows, the month headers and the totals of the whole range, the facets of the chips and the movements waiting for a category.

post.summary: Hides, restores or deletes for good (hidden rows only) a selection, with the balance of a manual movement's account kept right. A synced row deleted is never imported again.
